ownAccessOnlyHint: Access and roles for this organization.
pageHint: This organization's accounts and their roles.

emptyState.title: Only your own access
emptyState.description: Invite more people and assign them a role: Admin, Writer, Treasurer or Reader.

explainRolesDescription: Each account has exactly one role per organization.
passwordHelpEdit: Only fill in to change the password. At least 12 characters.
passwordHelpCreate: Required only for login. At least 12 characters.
enableLoginDescription: Set an email address and password for this participant’s login.

roleDescriptions.admin: Full access within the organization, including structure (templates, cycles, settings) and participant management.
roleDescriptions.writer: Works in the protocol area and maintains operational data, but changes neither structure nor finances.
roleDescriptions.kassier: Like reader, plus full write access to finances and fines.
roleDescriptions.reader: Read-only access, can trigger PDF exports and only sees their own fines.

toasts.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete participant "{name}"? The account and access are lost immediately.
